purpose: Enforce the three research priorities: orthogonal information first, early robustness visibility, and immediate independent replication after a complete formal pass.

orthogonal_search.principle: Prefer genuinely different information clocks and economic mechanisms over additional variants of already-tested price-only momentum/trend constructions.
preferred_families: Treasury auction demand and fiscal-liquidity states
cross-family consensus only after component validity
orthogonal_search.anti_convergence_rule: A new candidate must declare its information source class and mechanism lineage. Reusing an existing price-only lineage requires an explicit new hypothesis and independent scientific justification.
orthogonal_search.scheduler_rule: At least one active deterministic research lane must come from an orthogonal information family; price-only lineage may not displace an eligible orthogonal lane on holdout/performance grounds.

early_robustness.rule: These dimensions must be observable from a preregistered, research-only robustness artifact before future performance authorization. No post-hoc threshold or parameter search is permitted.
early_robustness.interpretation_rule: A diagnostic can expose weakness and block authorization; it cannot be used to tune the candidate until it passes.

immediate_replication.action: Immediately enqueue the preregistered independent replication without modifying the passed candidate.
requirements_predeclared_before_performa: fresh symbol-disjoint validation universe or otherwise explicitly independent data source
no parameter, threshold, horizon, asset or holdout search after the pass
immediate_replication.failure_mode: If a replication contract is missing, the post-pass dispatcher must fail closed rather than infer or invent a replication path.
immediate_replication.promotion_rule: A formal pass creates no promotion authority; replication and subsequent governance remain mandatory.

candidate_robustness_gate.rule: Every candidate entering any formal phase must carry a completed structural robustness receipt produced from the frozen candidate contract. The gate is descriptive/structural only and cannot use returns, holdouts, ranking or tuning.

literature_discovery.anti_convergence: Prefer a genuinely new information mechanism over another price-only momentum/trend variant. A rediscovered mechanism requires a materially new falsifiable premise.
literature_discovery.source_claim_boundary: Paper results and external empirical claims are never project evidence.
